security_audit.summary: All 34 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, documentation links, and fixed skill memory paths. No executable commands, data-exfiltration intent, or prompt-injection attempt was found.

remediation.issue: Static scanners may mistake Markdown code spans and fenced examples for shell execution.
remediation.suggestion: Use prose or clearly labelled non-executable examples where practical, and keep command-like syntax out of documentation headings.

remediation.issue: Relative repository links trigger path-traversal heuristics.
remediation.suggestion: Document that links are fixed internal references and that output paths are not constructed from untrusted input.

content.value_statement: Campaign teams need clear controls to prevent ads from appearing in unsuitable placements. This skill creates an evidence-backed exclusion plan and packages the material for an A1 brand-safety review.
actual_capabilities: Creates site, app, channel, and network exclusion recommendations from a placement report.
Lists content-suitability tiers and sensitive-topic blocks that match stated brand constraints.
Separates measured placement findings from user-provided brand-safety rules.
Records reach-versus-safety tradeoffs for network participation decisions.
Packages placement references and rationales as A1 evidence for a separate auditor.
Identifies a missing placement report and stops with a request for input.
limitations: It does not access advertising accounts or export reports for the user.
It cannot verify current platform settings without user-provided evidence.
It does not create audience suppression segments or targeted audiences.
It does not issue an A1 verdict or calculate an account quality score.

use_cases.title: Prepare a launch exclusion plan
use_cases.description: Turn a new campaign goal and brand rules into placement, network, and content exclusions before spend begins.

use_cases.title: Review unsafe placements
use_cases.description: Use a placement report to document low-quality, irrelevant, or off-brand placements with concise rationales.

use_cases.title: Assemble audit evidence
use_cases.description: Package placement evidence and exclusion decisions for a separate brand-safety or account audit.

prompt_templates.title: Start an exclusion plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Build brand-safety exclusion lists for my ecommerce launch on Google Ads. Exclude sensitive news and competitor placements.

prompt_templates.title: Review a placement report
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this placement report for my B2B campaign. List unsuitable sites and apps, label each finding as measured, and explain the exclusion.

prompt_templates.title: Set network controls
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend Search partner, Display expansion, and Audience network opt-outs for a lead-generation campaign. Explain each reach and safety tradeoff.

prompt_templates.title: Package audit evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Create A1 brand-safety evidence from this placements report and these exclusion decisions. Do not assign an A1 verdict.

output_examples.input: Exclude placements that conflict with a family-safe product launch.
output: Placement exclusions: identified unsuitable sites and apps with reasons.
Content blocks: sensitive news, tragedy adjacency, and adult themes.
Evidence status: requires the placement report before A1 evidence is complete.

output_examples.input: Prepare network exclusions for a tightly controlled B2B campaign.
output: Network decision: evaluate Search partners, Display expansion, and Audience network separately.
Rationale: prioritize control and documented brand suitability over maximum reach.
Handoff: package decisions for the account auditor.

best_practices: Provide a recent placement report and the campaign goal before requesting exclusions.
State non-negotiable brand-safety rules separately from performance preferences.
Review exclusion decisions with the account owner before saving or applying them.
anti_patterns: Do not infer a safe placement list when the placement report is missing.
Do not treat audience exclusions as placement exclusions or recreate another skill’s audience set.
Do not use the plan as a substitute for platform review or an auditor’s verdict.

faq.question: Does this skill connect to my ad account?
faq.answer: No. Provide your own account exports or placement reports.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a campaign goal, platforms, brand-safety constraints, and a placement report when available.

faq.question: Can it create audience exclusions?
faq.answer: No. It references an existing audience exclusion set and does not create suppression segments.

faq.question: Can it decide whether my account passes A1?
faq.answer: No. It prepares evidence for a separate account auditor.

faq.question: What happens if I have no placement report?
faq.answer: The skill marks qualified evidence as unknown and requests the report instead of guessing.

faq.question: Can it apply exclusions in an ad platform?
faq.answer: No. It produces recommendations and evidence. You must review and apply settings in your platform.
